title: Polydogs Network
tagline: A decentralized social network to connect dog breeders/owners/lovers, allow exchange information, help find shelter and food to abandoned dogs, create a safe place to dog breeders do business and more...
description: A decentralized social network to connect dog breeders/owners/lovers and to help find shelter and food to abandoned/rescued dogs, create a safe place to dog breeders do business, to allow dog breeders create digital pedigree certificates, to allow dog breeders stream live video from their marketplace ads while answering questions about their puppies.
how_its_made: This projects uses lens protocol to allow a marketplace/classifieds, a kennel, amateur breeder and Owners profiles creation, create user feed feature, curated publications, follow kennels/breeders, allow comments,  and share posts with monetization, allow create digital pedigree certificates. Using lit protocol to create protected content to allow partnerships between breeders, pet shops and vets. Using livepeer protocol to allow stream live video while answering potential new dog owners question.
